brief:
Israeli occupation forces and settlers stormed the villages of Turmusayya and Deir Jareer, according to Shehab Wire. The raids represent a continuation of coordinated military and settler operations targeting Palestinian communities in the West Bank.

The timing and scale of the incursions were not immediately specified. Turmusayya and Deir Jareer are among numerous Palestinian villages that have experienced repeated raids by Israeli forces and settler groups in recent months. Such operations typically involve searches of homes and confrontations with residents, though specific details of Friday's raids remained unclear at the time of reporting.
